links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-3.5 OSA patient education responses (FRE, FKGL) versus Google Search
links.effect: Google Search responses were easier to read (FRE: 56.05 vs. 22.00; FKGL: 9.00 vs. 14.00, p < 0.0001); ChatGPT-3.5 output was less readable.
links.quote: Readability analysis revealed that Google Search responses were easier to read (FRE: 56.05 vs. 22.00; FKGL: 9.00 vs. 14.00, p < 0.0001).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-3.5 compared to Google Search for generating patient education material on obstructive sleep apnea using standardized quality and readability metrics.
